body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia**_

A documentation-only change: `docs/tangles/ui/dividers-and-lines.org` (a page, no code), its entry in `docs/main.org` and the CHANGELOG.

- **This configuration:** what to set for the dotted line under `M-x` (`sp-mini-frame-divider-char`, `-priority`, colour and opacity through `sp-nano-style-divider-*`), the line above the mode line and under the header, and the window dividers and borders of `sp-windows` (which paints them with the background).
- **In general:** window dividers (`window-divider-mode`, widths, faces), frame and child-frame borders, fringes and margins, lines made of face attributes (`:overline`, `:underline`, `:box`, `:extend`), characters, and display properties; how to find the face of any line.

**Not checked:** nothing was run in Emacs. The variable and face names come from the Emacs manuals and the modules of this configuration; the examples have not been evaluated.

---
